D10_evidence: Human Table3 interval4047–4129(83nt) is independently published. This does not establish or silently correct the conflicting mouse GenBank D10 interval3272–3819.
table_source_note_paraphrase: Paper locates divergence-domain intervals by aligning sequences to the mouse domain boundaries from Hassouna et al.1984.
mapping_caveat: These are published human source boundaries, not direct fungal annotations. Fungal target projections require unique supported conserved flanks, proper order, and disclosure of method/quality; failed projections remain unresolved.
